Italian poker variant (also known as Teresina). The Italian form of five-card stud, played with a stripped deck whose size depends on the number of players.

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4
Partnerships: Optional

Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included

Standard 52-card deck
Score sheet (optional)
Table space

Ante first. Each player receives two cards (one down, one up), dealt clockwise. After first betting round, one face-up card per active player, then betting; repeat until each has four face-up and one face-down (five cards total). Dealing pattern: clockwise.

items.text: Telesina Con Vela: One card (la vela) is dealt face down to the table at the start. After the five-card hands and final betting round, la vela is turned face up and there is a final round of betting. In showdown, la vela is a community card; each player makes the best five-card hand from five in hand plus la vela.

Telesina with Joker (Con Matte): Dealer selects a rank (e.g. nines) and all cards of that rank are wild. Wild can represent any card; four of a kind plus a wild makes pokerissimo, ranking above straight flush.

Telesina con carte coperte: All cards dealt face down. After two cards each, each player reveals one card of choice before first betting round; after each subsequent deal, players choose which card to reveal so that each has one face-down and the rest face-up.
Telesina con una carta coperta: All cards dealt face up except the first and the last. Before the final betting round, each player chooses to show either the first or the last card.
